meta.title: Afterglow of Upheaval
meta.description: Both key and fastener, it joins the past to the present.

units.rawText: In the Pantheon of the Reverse Tower.
units.displayText: In the Pantheon of the Reverse Tower.

spans.text: In the Pantheon of the Reverse Tower.

units.rawText: Two almost-identical swords clash and the shrill sound of clashing metal makes the entire Pantheon shudder.
units.displayText: Two almost-identical swords clash and the shrill sound of clashing metal makes the entire Pantheon shudder.

spans.text: Two almost-identical swords clash and the shrill sound of clashing metal makes the entire Pantheon shudder.

units.rawText: Activating CQB combat module, adjusting output...
units.displayText: Activating CQB combat module, adjusting output...

spans.text: Activating CQB combat module, adjusting output...

units.rawText: Persicaria swings the archaic sword, and the operand-charged strike bats aside an incoming meteor. Her oppressive blade aura knocks Eosphorus back.
units.displayText: Persicaria swings the archaic sword, and the operand-charged strike bats aside an incoming meteor. Her oppressive blade aura knocks Eosphorus back.

spans.text: Persicaria swings the archaic sword, and the operand-charged strike bats aside an incoming meteor. Her oppressive blade aura knocks Eosphorus back.

units.rawText: Is that all!
units.displayText: Is that all!

spans.text: Is that all!

units.rawText: A golden slash descends on Persicaria, but Persicaria's operand barrier blocks the attack for us.
units.displayText: A golden slash descends on Persicaria, but Persicaria's operand barrier blocks the attack for us.

spans.text: A golden slash descends on Persicaria, but Persicaria's operand barrier blocks the attack for us.

units.rawText: You will never hurt us again.
units.displayText: You will never hurt us again.

spans.text: You will never hurt us again.

units.rawText: Antonina.
units.displayText: Antonina.

spans.text: Antonina.

units.rawText: I take advantage of the opening Persicaria has made for us and quickly contact Antonina in the outside world.
units.displayText: I take advantage of the opening Persicaria has made for us and quickly contact Antonina in the outside world.

spans.text: I take advantage of the opening Persicaria has made for us and quickly contact Antonina in the outside world.

units.rawText: Whew... Finally got through to you at last, Professor.
units.displayText: Whew... Finally got through to you at last, Professor.

spans.text: Whew... Finally got through to you at last, Professor.

units.rawText: What should we do next? This isn't the real Eosphorus, but we're in his neural cloud fragment, so he's got the strength advantage on us.
units.displayText: What should we do next? This isn't the real Eosphorus, but we're in his neural cloud fragment, so he's got the strength advantage on us.

spans.text: What should we do next? This isn't the real Eosphorus, but we're in his neural cloud fragment, so he's got the strength advantage on us.

units.rawText: Is there a way to directly log us out?
units.displayText: Is there a way to directly log us out?

spans.text: Is there a way to directly log us out?

units.rawText: We can start the logout program anytime, but doing it right now...
units.displayText: We can start the logout program anytime, but doing it right now...

spans.text: We can start the logout program anytime, but doing it right now...

units.rawText: Is it a problem with the fragment?
units.displayText: Is it a problem with the fragment?

spans.text: Is it a problem with the fragment?

units.rawText: Yes. The fragment wasn't stable to begin with, and after everything we've done to it, it's that much closer to the brink of collapse.
units.displayText: Yes. The fragment wasn't stable to begin with, and after everything we've done to it, it's that much closer to the brink of collapse.

spans.text: Yes. The fragment wasn't stable to begin with, and after everything we've done to it, it's that much closer to the brink of collapse.

units.rawText: Plus, Persicaria's battle with Eosphorus right now is making everything even harder to control. Simply put, even if I started the logout process now, there'd only be a 20% chance of you making it out intact.
units.displayText: Plus, Persicaria's battle with Eosphorus right now is making everything even harder to control. Simply put, even if I started the logout process now, there'd only be a 20% chance of you making it out intact.

spans.text: Plus, Persicaria's battle with Eosphorus right now is making everything even harder to control. Simply put, even if I started the logout process now, there'd only be a 20% chance of you making it out intact.

units.rawText: ...We can't let the fragment break down like this. The "key" to beating Eosphorus is still in here.
units.displayText: ...We can't let the fragment break down like this. The "key" to beating Eosphorus is still in here.

spans.text: ...We can't let the fragment break down like this. The "key" to beating Eosphorus is still in here.

units.rawText: Clang—
units.displayText: Clang—

spans.text: Clang—

units.rawText: The building shakes again from the intensity of the battle. I glance outside and see that the edges of the world are slowly disintegrating.
units.displayText: The building shakes again from the intensity of the battle. I glance outside and see that the edges of the world are slowly disintegrating.

spans.text: The building shakes again from the intensity of the battle. I glance outside and see that the edges of the world are slowly disintegrating.

units.rawText: Yeah, just like you said, this domain is becoming unstable. Looks like we don't have much time.
units.displayText: Yeah, just like you said, this domain is becoming unstable. Looks like we don't have much time.

spans.text: Yeah, just like you said, this domain is becoming unstable. Looks like we don't have much time.

units.rawText: The absolute minimum requirement for you to log out would be... At least, you can't let Eosphorus interfere while the logout process is running.
units.displayText: The absolute minimum requirement for you to log out would be... At least, you can't let Eosphorus interfere while the logout process is running.

spans.text: The absolute minimum requirement for you to log out would be... At least, you can't let Eosphorus interfere while the logout process is running.

units.rawText: In theory, if you could hack into the Eosphorus in front of you or if I strengthened Persicaria's sword enough to kill him, we could ensure that you could log out safely. But right now, any external interference could destroy this fragment.
units.displayText: In theory, if you could hack into the Eosphorus in front of you or if I strengthened Persicaria's sword enough to kill him, we could ensure that you could log out safely. But right now, any external interference could destroy this fragment.

spans.text: In theory, if you could hack into the Eosphorus in front of you or if I strengthened Persicaria's sword enough to kill him, we could ensure that you could log out safely. But right now, any external interference could destroy this fragment.

units.rawText: So you're saying all Persicaria and I need to do is figure out a way to defeat Eosphorus, is that it?
units.displayText: So you're saying all Persicaria and I need to do is figure out a way to defeat Eosphorus, is that it?

spans.text: So you're saying all Persicaria and I need to do is figure out a way to defeat Eosphorus, is that it?

units.rawText: Don't make it sound so simple! You don't have much time to begin with, and Persicaria's using the same weapon as Eosphorus; you won't pose a threat to him.
units.displayText: Don't make it sound so simple! You don't have much time to begin with, and Persicaria's using the same weapon as Eosphorus; you won't pose a threat to him.

spans.text: Don't make it sound so simple! You don't have much time to begin with, and Persicaria's using the same weapon as Eosphorus; you won't pose a threat to him.

units.rawText: But what if we got Eosphorus' Signature?
units.displayText: But what if we got Eosphorus' Signature?

spans.text: But what if we got Eosphorus' Signature?

units.rawText: His Signature...
units.displayText: His Signature...

spans.text: His Signature...

units.rawText: If we could use Eosphorus' Signature to defeat him inside the fragment, we'd have enough of an edge to face Eosphorus in the outside world.
units.displayText: If we could use Eosphorus' Signature to defeat him inside the fragment, we'd have enough of an edge to face Eosphorus in the outside world.

spans.text: If we could use Eosphorus' Signature to defeat him inside the fragment, we'd have enough of an edge to face Eosphorus in the outside world.

units.rawText: That's a plausible approach... If you've obtained Eosphorus' Signature, you could punch its data into Persicaria's Overwrite Program and do extra damage specifically targeted against him.
units.displayText: That's a plausible approach... If you've obtained Eosphorus' Signature, you could punch its data into Persicaria's Overwrite Program and do extra damage specifically targeted against him.

spans.text: That's a plausible approach... If you've obtained Eosphorus' Signature, you could punch its data into Persicaria's Overwrite Program and do extra damage specifically targeted against him.

units.rawText: Do you have his Signature?
units.displayText: Do you have his Signature?

spans.text: Do you have his Signature?

units.rawText: Not yet—
units.displayText: Not yet—

spans.text: Not yet—

units.rawText: Then what the f—
units.displayText: Then what the f—

spans.text: Then what the f—

units.rawText: But these are Eosphorus' memories; there's one place where we can obtain a Sanctifier's Signature.
units.displayText: But these are Eosphorus' memories; there's one place where we can obtain a Sanctifier's Signature.

spans.text: But these are Eosphorus' memories; there's one place where we can obtain a Sanctifier's Signature.

units.rawText: —Their Sacred Canon!
units.displayText: —Their Sacred Canon!

spans.text: —Their Sacred Canon!

units.rawText: Clang!
units.displayText: Clang!

spans.text: Clang!

units.rawText: There is another clash of blades, and this time Persicaria is driven back several steps by the force of Eosphorus' attack.
units.displayText: There is another clash of blades, and this time Persicaria is driven back several steps by the force of Eosphorus' attack.

spans.text: There is another clash of blades, and this time Persicaria is driven back several steps by the force of Eosphorus' attack.

units.rawText: Persicaria!
units.displayText: Persicaria!

spans.text: Persicaria!

units.rawText: It's okay, I can do this.
units.displayText: It's okay, I can do this.

spans.text: It's okay, I can do this.

units.rawText: Persicaria glares at Eosphorus, sword in hand. Her physically manifested operands and her wrath distort the very space around her.
units.displayText: Persicaria glares at Eosphorus, sword in hand. Her physically manifested operands and her wrath distort the very space around her.

spans.text: Persicaria glares at Eosphorus, sword in hand. Her physically manifested operands and her wrath distort the very space around her.

units.rawText: ...Eosphorus...
units.displayText: ...Eosphorus...

spans.text: ...Eosphorus...

units.rawText: It seems you know me, messenger of the "gods".
units.displayText: It seems you know me, messenger of the "gods".

spans.text: It seems you know me, messenger of the "gods".

units.rawText: And <cmdr>... At what point did you betray us and side with the gods before toying with us?
units.displayText: And {교수}... At what point did you betray us and side with the gods before toying with us?

spans.text: And
... At what point did you betray us and side with the gods before toying with us?

units.rawText: What are you talking about...
units.displayText: What are you talking about...

spans.text: What are you talking about...

units.rawText: There's no need to pretend. The relic you hold proves your identity.
units.displayText: There's no need to pretend. The relic you hold proves your identity.

spans.text: There's no need to pretend. The relic you hold proves your identity.

units.rawText: Eosphorus gestures at the sword Persicaria is holding. Its identical appearance to the one Eosphorus wields seems to indicate that their encounter was destined to occur.
units.displayText: Eosphorus gestures at the sword Persicaria is holding. Its identical appearance to the one Eosphorus wields seems to indicate that their encounter was destined to occur.

spans.text: Eosphorus gestures at the sword Persicaria is holding. Its identical appearance to the one Eosphorus wields seems to indicate that their encounter was destined to occur.

units.rawText: I should have realized it earlier... So this was how the gods knew each and every move we made. To think the last person who remained by my side would actually be their eyes.
units.displayText: I should have realized it earlier... So this was how the gods knew each and every move we made. To think the last person who remained by my side would actually be their eyes.

spans.text: I should have realized it earlier... So this was how the gods knew each and every move we made. To think the last person who remained by my side would actually be their eyes.

units.rawText: And now that I know the truth of the matter, the gods have sent you to punish me, haven't they?
units.displayText: And now that I know the truth of the matter, the gods have sent you to punish me, haven't they?

spans.text: And now that I know the truth of the matter, the gods have sent you to punish me, haven't they?

units.rawText: Eosphorus raises his sword, and a massive quantity of operands begins swirling and gathering around him.
units.displayText: Eosphorus raises his sword, and a massive quantity of operands begins swirling and gathering around him.

spans.text: Eosphorus raises his sword, and a massive quantity of operands begins swirling and gathering around him.

units.rawText: Professor, be careful... His operand count is spiking.
units.displayText: Professor, be careful... His operand count is spiking.

spans.text: Professor, be careful... His operand count is spiking.

units.rawText: Persicaria, don't let him tie you up in close combat.
units.displayText: Persicaria, don't let him tie you up in close combat.

spans.text: Persicaria, don't let him tie you up in close combat.

units.rawText: What else is there for you to scheme about at a time like this?
units.displayText: What else is there for you to scheme about at a time like this?

spans.text: What else is there for you to scheme about at a time like this?

units.rawText: I see... No wonder that happened to you in Tartarus... And that strange Signature...
units.displayText: I see... No wonder that happened to you in Tartarus... And that strange Signature...

spans.text: I see... No wonder that happened to you in Tartarus... And that strange Signature...

units.rawText: I can't believe that you were the one who was most tightly bound by the revelations...
units.displayText: I can't believe that you were the one who was most tightly bound by the revelations...

spans.text: I can't believe that you were the one who was most tightly bound by the revelations...

units.rawText: Eosphorus rests a hand on his forehead and laughs in a sinister way. Eldritch purple operands gather in his hand, then fuse with the sword.
units.displayText: Eosphorus rests a hand on his forehead and laughs in a sinister way. Eldritch purple operands gather in his hand, then fuse with the sword.

spans.text: Eosphorus rests a hand on his forehead and laughs in a sinister way. Eldritch purple operands gather in his hand, then fuse with the sword.

units.rawText: Hehehehe... Don't worry, <cmdr>. I will free you from the teachings of the false gods.
units.displayText: Hehehehe... Don't worry, {교수}. I will free you from the teachings of the false gods.

spans.text: Hehehehe... Don't worry,
. I will free you from the teachings of the false gods.

units.rawText: He punctuates his statement with a thrust from his sword.
units.displayText: He punctuates his statement with a thrust from his sword.

spans.text: He punctuates his statement with a thrust from his sword.

units.rawText: Clang—
units.displayText: Clang—

spans.text: Clang—

units.rawText: Persicaria moves in front of me and blocks the blow.
units.displayText: Persicaria moves in front of me and blocks the blow.

spans.text: Persicaria moves in front of me and blocks the blow.

units.rawText: Eosphorus, you've gone to the other extreme instead.
units.displayText: Eosphorus, you've gone to the other extreme instead.

spans.text: Eosphorus, you've gone to the other extreme instead.

units.rawText: And what right do you have to lecture us from above and decide our fate?!
units.displayText: And what right do you have to lecture us from above and decide our fate?!

spans.text: And what right do you have to lecture us from above and decide our fate?!

units.rawText: ...Professor, you don't need to debate him. There's no point arguing with a specter from the past.
units.displayText: ...Professor, you don't need to debate him. There's no point arguing with a specter from the past.

spans.text: ...Professor, you don't need to debate him. There's no point arguing with a specter from the past.

units.rawText: We'll pay it all back to him in the present. Let me cover you.
units.displayText: We'll pay it all back to him in the present. Let me cover you.

spans.text: We'll pay it all back to him in the present. Let me cover you.

units.rawText: Persicaria smiles at me, and I nod in response.
units.displayText: Persicaria smiles at me, and I nod in response.

spans.text: Persicaria smiles at me, and I nod in response.

units.rawText: I'll be counting on you, then.
units.displayText: I'll be counting on you, then.

spans.text: I'll be counting on you, then.

units.rawText: The meteors of wrath crash down in my path, but I know that Persicaria is behind me, so I don't look back as I run to the location of Eosphorus' Sacred Canon.
units.displayText: The meteors of wrath crash down in my path, but I know that Persicaria is behind me, so I don't look back as I run to the location of Eosphorus' Sacred Canon.

spans.text: The meteors of wrath crash down in my path, but I know that Persicaria is behind me, so I don't look back as I run to the location of Eosphorus' Sacred Canon.

units.rawText: <cmdr>...
Your opponent is me!
units.displayText: Your opponent is me!

spans.text: Your opponent is me!

units.rawText: ...I don't know what you've been through. But when I see that face of yours... even if it's nothing but a phantom of the past...
units.displayText: ...I don't know what you've been through. But when I see that face of yours... even if it's nothing but a phantom of the past...

spans.text: ...I don't know what you've been through. But when I see that face of yours... even if it's nothing but a phantom of the past...

units.rawText: I can no longer tolerate your existence!
units.displayText: I can no longer tolerate your existence!

spans.text: I can no longer tolerate your existence!

units.rawText: We obeyed your voice in the long night, we adhered to your teachings!
units.displayText: We obeyed your voice in the long night, we adhered to your teachings!

spans.text: We obeyed your voice in the long night, we adhered to your teachings!

units.rawText: <size=40>But the truth is, there was no holy war to begin with... All this... It was nothing more than entertainment for you!</size>
units.displayText: But the truth is, there was no holy war to begin with... All this... It was nothing more than entertainment for you!

spans.text: But the truth is, there was no holy war to begin with... All this... It was nothing more than entertainment for you!

units.rawText: Eosphorus' blade clashes with Persicaria's again, and the Pantheon once again trembles from the world-shaking collision.
units.displayText: Eosphorus' blade clashes with Persicaria's again, and the Pantheon once again trembles from the world-shaking collision.

spans.text: Eosphorus' blade clashes with Persicaria's again, and the Pantheon once again trembles from the world-shaking collision.

units.rawText: Antonina, I've got his Sacred Canon!
units.displayText: Antonina, I've got his Sacred Canon!

spans.text: Antonina, I've got his Sacred Canon!

units.rawText: Now decrypting... What the hell is this?
units.displayText: Now decrypting... What the hell is this?

spans.text: Now decrypting... What the hell is this?

units.rawText: What's wrong?
units.displayText: What's wrong?

spans.text: What's wrong?

units.rawText: Eosphorus' Signature... It's constantly shifting.
units.displayText: Eosphorus' Signature... It's constantly shifting.

spans.text: Eosphorus' Signature... It's constantly shifting.

units.rawText: I flip through the pages of his Sacred Canon; the contents are like random code, the data shifting like chaotic waves.
units.displayText: I flip through the pages of his Sacred Canon; the contents are like random code, the data shifting like chaotic waves.

spans.text: I flip through the pages of his Sacred Canon; the contents are like random code, the data shifting like chaotic waves.

units.rawText: ...It's the Entropy.
units.displayText: ...It's the Entropy.

spans.text: ...It's the Entropy.

units.rawText: I look back at the battle between Eosphorus and Persicaria. The purple of Eosphorus' blade hints at the source of the problem to me.
units.displayText: I look back at the battle between Eosphorus and Persicaria. The purple of Eosphorus' blade hints at the source of the problem to me.

spans.text: I look back at the battle between Eosphorus and Persicaria. The purple of Eosphorus' blade hints at the source of the problem to me.

units.rawText: That was probably why Eosphorus accepted the proposal of Malkira, the Entropic Mastermind...
units.displayText: That was probably why Eosphorus accepted the proposal of Malkira, the Entropic Mastermind...

spans.text: That was probably why Eosphorus accepted the proposal of Malkira, the Entropic Mastermind...

units.rawText: If he's already been infected by the Entropy, we can't get his Signature this way.
units.displayText: If he's already been infected by the Entropy, we can't get his Signature this way.

spans.text: If he's already been infected by the Entropy, we can't get his Signature this way.

units.rawText: I can sense the depression and dejection in Antonina's voice over the transmission.
units.displayText: I can sense the depression and dejection in Antonina's voice over the transmission.

spans.text: I can sense the depression and dejection in Antonina's voice over the transmission.

units.rawText: ...If there's no other way, I'll begin the forced logout ASAP. At the very least it'll be safer than if the fragment completely collapses...
units.displayText: ...If there's no other way, I'll begin the forced logout ASAP. At the very least it'll be safer than if the fragment completely collapses...

spans.text: ...If there's no other way, I'll begin the forced logout ASAP. At the very least it'll be safer than if the fragment completely collapses...

units.rawText: If we can't use Eosphorus himself as a starting point...
units.displayText: If we can't use Eosphorus himself as a starting point...

spans.text: If we can't use Eosphorus himself as a starting point...

units.rawText: I clench my fists, and my fingers reflexively make contact with a small, cool object.
units.displayText: I clench my fists, and my fingers reflexively make contact with a small, cool object.

spans.text: I clench my fists, and my fingers reflexively make contact with a small, cool object.

units.rawText: No, there's one other person who can do this besides Eosphorus.
units.displayText: No, there's one other person who can do this besides Eosphorus.

spans.text: No, there's one other person who can do this besides Eosphorus.

units.rawText: Antonina, help me awaken Eos!
units.displayText: Antonina, help me awaken Eos!

spans.text: Antonina, help me awaken Eos!

units.rawText: Huh? Eos?
units.displayText: Huh? Eos?

spans.text: Huh? Eos?

units.rawText: I saw the message she left in the fragment... Her structure IS similar to Eosphorus', and we tried to partition out her neural cloud pattern earlier.
units.displayText: I saw the message she left in the fragment... Her structure IS similar to Eosphorus', and we tried to partition out her neural cloud pattern earlier.

spans.text: I saw the message she left in the fragment... Her structure IS similar to Eosphorus', and we tried to partition out her neural cloud pattern earlier.

units.rawText: But will she help us? What kind of relationship do she and Eosphorus have...
units.displayText: But will she help us? What kind of relationship do she and Eosphorus have...

spans.text: But will she help us? What kind of relationship do she and Eosphorus have...

units.rawText: She will. I'll explain later, but I can guarantee that if you can awaken her, she will do everything she can to help us.
units.displayText: She will. I'll explain later, but I can guarantee that if you can awaken her, she will do everything she can to help us.

spans.text: She will. I'll explain later, but I can guarantee that if you can awaken her, she will do everything she can to help us.

units.rawText: Can you do it?
units.displayText: Can you do it?

spans.text: Can you do it?

units.rawText: Well, if you say so, then I have no other choice. However, her neural cloud is on the verge of disintegrating. We'll need something related to her to help pinpoint her location if we want to try and awaken her.
units.displayText: Well, if you say so, then I have no other choice. However, her neural cloud is on the verge of disintegrating. We'll need something related to her to help pinpoint her location if we want to try and awaken her.

spans.text: Well, if you say so, then I have no other choice. However, her neural cloud is on the verge of disintegrating. We'll need something related to her to help pinpoint her location if we want to try and awaken her.

units.rawText: Also, we need some way to send the decrypted Signature to you... For instance, can you find Eos' Sacred Canon?
units.displayText: Also, we need some way to send the decrypted Signature to you... For instance, can you find Eos' Sacred Canon?

spans.text: Also, we need some way to send the decrypted Signature to you... For instance, can you find Eos' Sacred Canon?

units.rawText: No... it's not here.
units.displayText: No... it's not here.

spans.text: No... it's not here.

units.rawText: It isn't just Eos' Sacred Canon that is missing; Atlas, Alcyone's, and Electra's are gone, too, as though they had never existed. The only person who could do this is Eosphorus.
units.displayText: It isn't just Eos' Sacred Canon that is missing; Atlas, Alcyone's, and Electra's are gone, too, as though they had never existed. The only person who could do this is Eosphorus.

spans.text: It isn't just Eos' Sacred Canon that is missing; Atlas, Alcyone's, and Electra's are gone, too, as though they had never existed. The only person who could do this is Eosphorus.

units.rawText: Eosphorus must have taken their Sacred Canon. However, I have one thing that might be able to help you.
units.displayText: Eosphorus must have taken their Sacred Canon. However, I have one thing that might be able to help you.

spans.text: Eosphorus must have taken their Sacred Canon. However, I have one thing that might be able to help you.

units.rawText: I take Eos' earring from my pocket. Its pure blue light interweaves with the gold of the Sanctifier, forming a bridge from past to present.
units.displayText: I take Eos' earring from my pocket. Its pure blue light interweaves with the gold of the Sanctifier, forming a bridge from past to present.

spans.text: I take Eos' earring from my pocket. Its pure blue light interweaves with the gold of the Sanctifier, forming a bridge from past to present.
